summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Rahaza Travel ERP Calendar Export & Enhancement features (Export PDF/Excel, Color by Vehicle, Week View with Timeline). All backend APIs and frontend features working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Export to Excel (GET /api/bookings/calendar/export?format=excel) returns valid xlsx file (5783 bytes)
Backend: Export to PDF (GET /api/bookings/calendar/export?format=pdf) returns valid PDF file (2936 bytes)
Backend: Export endpoint auth protection (401 without token)
Backend: Calendar endpoint regression (GET /api/bookings/calendar) returns 5 bookings
Frontend: Login successful with owner@demo.local
Frontend: Calendar page loads with 'Kalender Keberangkatan' heading
Frontend: Export buttons exist (data-testid: dc-export-excel, dc-export-pdf)
Frontend: Color toggle works - Status/Armada buttons (dc-color-status, dc-color-vehicle)
Frontend: Color toggle changes legend to show vehicle names (Hiace Premio 01, Hiace Premio 02, Isuzu Elf Long 01, Hiace Commuter Mitra)
Frontend: Color toggle changes event colors in calendar grid
Frontend: Week view toggle works (dc-view-week)
Frontend: Week view displays timeline with hours (dc-week)
Frontend: Week view label shows week range (e.g., '3 Agu – 9 Agu 2026')
Frontend: Week view shows 6 events positioned at correct times
Frontend: Week view shows conflicts side-by-side using lane packing (visible on Aug 4 and Aug 7-8)
Frontend: Navigation buttons work (dc-prev, dc-next, dc-today)
Frontend: Navigation in week mode shifts by week (label changed from '3 Agu – 9 Agu 2026' to '10 Agu – 16 Agu 2026')
Frontend: Detail panel opens from week view event click
Frontend: Detail panel shows all fields (customer, vehicle, route, start, end)
Frontend: Detail panel back button works (dc-detail-back)
Frontend: Create booking dialog opens (dc-create-open)
Frontend: Create booking dialog has start field with prefill (bf-start shows '08/04/2026, 08:00 AM')
Frontend: Create booking dialog closes properly (Escape key)

Frontend: Month view grid displays correctly
